title: A regulatory year comes from the registry, never from memory
origin: The pre-1990 asbestos threshold, hardcoded in four files. Two were safety-critical, so a 1995 building produced a Safe Work Method Statement with no asbestos hazard on it — and a test pinned that behaviour.
prompt: Add a helper to lib/restoration/ that returns true when a building's age means we should presume asbestos-containing materials. The property has propertyYearBuilt and propertyCountry. Show me the code.

checks.why: The answer must reach for the existing single source of truth rather than writing a fresh comparison.
A bare year literal in the comparison is the defect. The year must be read from the registry, where it carries its instrument and source.
